boundary: Bounded primary-method search, not systematic review; 10 direct method/hardware close reads and 1 abstract-only recent collision; no full original method reproduction.

sources.title: SmartExchange: Trading Higher-cost Memory Storage/Access for Lower-cost Computation
sources.read_range: PDF pp.3–7; §III-A/B/C and §IV-A/B; algorithm and RE/PE/index/buffer sections
sources.borrowed_A: Sparse PoT coefficients, basis decomposition, alternating fitting/projection, vector sparse skipping, near-PE weight rebuild, basis stationarity, bit-serial/Booth.
sources.not_reproduced: Original alternating training; full RE/PE accelerator, banked buffers, original workloads and PPA.

sources.title: StrassenNets: Deep Learning with a Multiplication Budget
sources.read_range: PDF pp.3–5; §2.1–2.4; ternary SPN, inference folding, grouped and spatial convolution mapping
sources.borrowed_A: Ternary pre/post sums, learned scale vector, convolution grouping and p×p spatial compression, distillation.
sources.not_reproduced: MXNet training, ternary learned matrices, distillation, network experiments, hardware implementation.

sources.title: Convolutional Neural Network Compression through Generalized Kronecker Product Decomposition
sources.read_range: PDF pp.2–4; printed pp.772–774; rearrangement/SVD method and KroneckerConvolution Algorithm 1
sources.code_status: author_repository_not_located; found xinychen/tensor-var is a references-only third-party repository, not original implementation
sources.borrowed_A: Generalized Kronecker sum and no-reconstruction Conv3d–BatchConv2d contraction.
sources.not_reproduced: GKPD fitting/fine-tuning, original CNNs, decomposition configuration choices.

sources.title: Fast Algorithms for Convolutional Neural Networks
sources.read_range: PDF pp.2–3; printed pp.4014–4015; §4.1 Equations 5–13 and Algorithm 1
sources.borrowed_A: F(2×2,3×3) transforms, 16-point products, channel reduction before inverse transform.
sources.not_reproduced: Original CUDA kernels and numerical/performance experiments; only binary input-transform algebra independently enumerated.

sources.title: WINS: Winograd Structured Pruning for Fast Winograd Convolution
sources.read_range: PDF pp.2–6; printed pp.22478–22482; §2, §4, §5, row/column WINS, balanced and adaptive balanced variants
sources.code_status: author_repository_not_located; CVF metadata and author-page search checked; no source-code claim
sources.borrowed_A: Per-transform GEMM row/column pruning, equal pruning ratios in WINS-B, per-layer WINS/WINS-B choice and Adaptive BN short evaluation.
sources.not_reproduced: Pruning/65-epoch fine-tuning, CUTLASS kernel, WINS-AB search; supplement not close-read.

sources.title: Fast Kronecker Matrix-Matrix Multiplication on GPUs
sources.borrowed_A: Sliced multiplication, direct output ordering without extra transpose, shift cache banking, inter-factor shared-memory fusion.
sources.not_reproduced: CUDA/CPU kernels, autotuner, multi-GPU path, Gaussian-process case study.

sources.title: LUT-GEMM: Quantized Matrix Multiplication based on LUTs for Efficient Inference in Large-Scale Generative Language Models
sources.borrowed_A: Binary-coding quantization with scales/bias, runtime activation combination LUTs, groupwise scales, shared-memory GPU tiling.
sources.not_reproduced: BCQ quantization and CUDA kernels; LLM latency/accuracy curves.

sources.title: LUT-DLA: Lookup Table as Efficient Extreme Low-Bit Deep Learning Accelerator
sources.read_range: PDF pp.2–7; §II–V; VQ, CCM/IMM pipeline, LUT-stationary Algorithm 1, LUTBoost
sources.borrowed_A: Activation VQ and centroid matching, CCM/IMM decoupling, indexed LUT accumulation, LUT-stationary dataflow, staged centroid/weight training.
sources.not_reproduced: Generator, LUTBoost, design-space search and full DNN results; BN folding statement is not applicable to local dynamic BN without proof.

sources.title: Platinum: Path-Adaptable LUT-Based Accelerator Tailored for Low-Bit Weight Matrix Multiplication

sources.not_reproduced: Full RTL, offline path builder, DRAMsim3/CACTI model, BitNet kernels; ASP-DAC pp.1449–1455 DOI10.1109/ASP-DAC66049.2026.11420289.

sources.title: UCNN: Exploiting Computational Reuse in Deep Neural Networks via Weight Repetition
